description: RudderStack JavaScript SDK (v3) cookies: each `raw` value (as in a Cookie header) URL-decodes, then decrypts ("RS_ENC_v3_" + base64 of UTF-8 JSON, or plain JSON without the prefix) to `decoded`; null means unreadable. Each `cookies` input (a Cookie header or a name-to-value map) yields `expected`: anonymous_id from rl_anonymous_id, user_id from rl_user_id, session_id from rl_session.id unless the session has ended (a numeric expiresAt in the past, or an enabled cutOff whose numeric expiresAt is in the past). Legacy v1.1 "RudderEncrypt:" (AES) values are not supported.

values.name: anonymous_id
values.description: An anonymousId as the browser writes it: encrypted, then URL-encoded.

values.name: anonymous_id_not_url_encoded
values.description: The same value without URL encoding (base64 "=" kept), as some servers set it.

values.name: user_id_unicode
values.description: A userId with non-ASCII characters: base64 of the UTF-8 JSON.

values.name: session_cut_off
values.description: A session object with a cut-off.

values.name: missing_base64_padding
values.description: Base64 without its "=" padding still decodes.

values.name: unencrypted_json_string
values.description: No prefix: the value is parsed as JSON (a quoted string).

values.name: unencrypted_bare_string
values.description: No prefix and not JSON: unreadable.

values.name: prefix_only
values.description: The prefix with nothing after it: unreadable.

values.name: malformed_base64
values.description: Not base64 after the prefix: unreadable.

values.name: truncated
values.description: Base64 of a JSON value cut short: unreadable.

values.name: legacy_v1_1
values.description: A legacy v1.1 AES value ("RudderEncrypt:"): not supported, unreadable.

identities.name: all_three
identities.description: All three cookies among unrelated ones.

identities.name: no_spaces_and_padding
identities.description: No space after ";", unencoded base64 padding in values: split on the first "=" only.

identities.name: whitespace_around_names_and_values
identities.description: Whitespace around names and values is trimmed; a segment without "=" is skipped.

identities.name: duplicate_name_last_wins
identities.description: A repeated cookie name keeps the last value, as the browser SDK reads it.

identities.name: map_decoded_values
identities.description: A name-to-value map with values already URL-decoded (cookie-parser, Next.js cookies()).

identities.name: map_url_encoded_values
identities.description: A name-to-value map with raw URL-encoded values.

identities.name: malformed_anonymous_id_valid_session
identities.description: An unreadable cookie is skipped; the others are still read.

identities.name: session_expired
identities.description: A session whose expiresAt is in the past has ended: no sessionId.

identities.name: session_cut_off_passed
identities.description: A session past its enabled cut-off (cutOff.expiresAt) has ended: no sessionId.

identities.name: session_manual_no_expiry
identities.description: A manual session has no expiresAt and stays valid.

identities.name: session_without_id
identities.description: A session object without an id gives no sessionId.

identities.name: session_id_string
identities.description: A string session id is not a session id (the JavaScript SDK always stores a number).

identities.name: session_id_zero
identities.description: Session id 0, as the JavaScript SDK drops it (`id || undefined`).

identities.name: session_id_not_integer
identities.description: A non-integer session id is ignored.

identities.name: session_number_not_object
identities.description: A bare number in rl_session is not a session object.

identities.name: non_string_ids
identities.description: Ids that are not non-empty strings are ignored.

identities.name: user_id_null
identities.description: rl_user_id holding null (after a reset) gives no userId.

identities.name: legacy_cookies
identities.description: Legacy v1.1 AES cookies are not supported: no identity.

identities.name: no_rudderstack_cookies
identities.description: Only unrelated cookies.

identities.name: empty_header
identities.description: An empty header.
